rationale: Both allowed files are implemented correctly and match all acceptance criteria. The router routes T1/T2/T4 to shadow_runner, bypasses LLM for T3/T5/T6/T7/T8, enforces both blocking guardrails (STRUCTURAL_FAIL and severe valence deviation), handles connection failures without raising, and returns a well-formed RouterResult with all required observability fields. All 27 new tests are substantive (non-tautological) and use proper mocking. The full 786-test suite passes with no regressions. No forbidden files were touched — git status shows only two untracked new files.
summary: Implementation fully satisfies P31-T1. All 11 acceptance criteria are met, all 27 new tests pass, 786 total tests pass, and only the two allowed files were created.
